name: Doras
summary: Above Orgrimmar, Doras directs the Horde's wind riders across Kalimdor. He oversees the capital's wyverns, sending couriers, scouts, and travelers on their way.

sections.title: Master of the Skyway
sections.body: Doras tends the wind riders on a wooden platform above the Valley of Strength. The Horde settled in Durotar, and these clever, leathery-winged beasts became its chief means of communication and travel across Kalimdor. Doras pairs resting mounts with riders and sees that important messages and reinforcements reach distant outposts. Their routes reach the Crossroads, Thunder Bluff, and settlements deep in Ashenvale or Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: Doras waits atop the flight tower overlooking Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Take the winding ramps up the central timber structures near the city entrance to reach his roost.
Doras manages wind riders, also called wyverns. Native to Kalimdor's arid crags and savannas, these intelligent, venomous winged predators befriended the Horde and carry riders over long distances.

aliases: where can i fly from orgrimmar
faq.answer: Doras sends travelers from Orgrimmar to Horde outposts across central and northern Kalimdor. These include the Crossroads in the Barrens, Thunder Bluff in Mulgore, and military camps in Ashenvale and beyond.

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer, you can rely on Doras for swift flights from the capital to allied settlements across Kalimdor.
